title: feat(core,react,vue,search,slash,toolbar): editor API, search, slash commands and toolbar enhancements

commits.message: feat: complete editor API search, slash toolbar & toolbar enhancements

fix(search,slash,toolbar): address code review issues

- search: guard against catastrophic backtracking in regexp mode with
  dangerous pattern detection and 2s execution timeout
- search: replace ASCII-only \\b with Unicode-aware word boundaries for
  wholeWord matching (supports CJK characters)
- slash: remove implicit default limit=10 in filterSlashCommands to avoid
  breaking change for hosts expecting all matches; Infinity is now default
- slash: fix duplicate identifier conflicts with core re-exports
- toolbar: fix getSelectedLines over-collecting when selection ends at
  line boundary (pos < to instead of pos <= to)
- toolbar: restore full selection range after toggleOrderedList and
  toggleUnorderedList instead of collapsing to caret
- update plugin-slash tests to match restored no-limit default behavior
